method: Parent directly inspected all seven final original UE PNGs with view_image after prop correction. Independent reviewer inspected refreshed evidence separately.

observations.overview: Coherent quiet farm; mill, barn, shed, four fenced fields and connected dirt approaches. Upright trees and architecture.
observations.top_down: Complete square 100m footprint visible; four fields and broad connected route visible, no blank capture.
observations.windmill: Readable canvas/lattice sails, tiled cap, wood gallery, stone entrance and plaster; rounded game art.
observations.farm_detail: Cart, barn facade, separated barrel and shed readable. Mill partly cropped intentionally for detail composition.
observations.prop_contact: Upper bale visibly supported on lower pair and all bales stand clear of barn rear wall; numerical gap/clearance saved separately.
observations.windmill_motion_t0_t1: Clearly changed sail angles in the same camera. Pixel difference includes moving shadow and temporal rendering, not isolated rotor-only measurement.

limitations: Dark shaded faces are intentional dynamic sun/skylight lighting.
This is visual review of recorded viewpoints, not an exhaustive every-actor contact or human-input walkthrough.
